movie.title: Voltei na Foto
movie.overview: Leonardo is a man frustrated with his life until, unexpectedly, he is transported back to 1986. In the past, he encounters his younger self and attempts to change his own future.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Frustrated with his current life, Leonardo unexpectedly travels back to 1986, where meeting his younger self presents a chance to rewrite his destiny.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Leonardo feels completely stagnant and unfulfilled with the way his life has turned out. Everything changes when he is magically transported back in time to 1986. Coming face-to-face with his younger self, he decides to intervene in key events of his past. He hopes that by guiding his youth, he can alter his trajectory and secure a better future.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Leonardo is an adult man stuck in a rut, harboring deep regret over the choices that led to his current disappointing life. His ordinary existence takes an extraordinary turn when a mysterious twist of fate lands him back in 1986. Disoriented at first, he soon realizes he has been given an unprecedented second chance at life. He crosses paths with his younger self, a version of him full of potential but about to make pivotal mistakes. Driven by a desire to fix his present, Leonardo takes on the role of an unasked-for mentor to his past self. As he tries to steer the young Leonardo toward smarter choices, he navigates the humorous and sentimental realities of the 1980s. However, changing the timeline proves trickier than anticipated as unexpected consequences unfold. Through their interactions, Leonardo is forced to confront what truly matters in life beyond his regrets. Ultimately, his journey through time becomes as much about self-acceptance as it is about altering his destiny.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Voltei na Foto is a heartwarming comedic drama about Leonardo, a man stuck in the dissatisfaction of his adult routine. When he unexpectedly slips back through time to the year 1986, he finds himself presented with a unique opportunity to interact with his younger self. Attempting to steer his youth away from past mistakes, Leonardo embarks on a nostalgic journey that blends lighthearted humor with poignant reflections on growth, choices, and second chances.

story_structure.climax: A critical turning point forces Leonardo to confront the unpredictable consequences of altering time and face the true source of his life's unhappiness.
story_structure.conflict: Unexpectedly transported back to 1986, Leonardo faces the dilemma of encountering his younger self and deciding whether to intervene in his own history.
story_structure.resolution: Leonardo achieves resolution by accepting the lessons learned from his journey, finding a new perspective on his choices, identity, and future.
story_structure.introduction: Leonardo is introduced living a deeply frustrating, unfulfilling life in the present day, burdened by regret over his past choices.
story_structure.risingAction: Leonardo interacts with his younger self, attempting to steer the boy toward different decisions and manipulate key events to secure a better future.
